messages:
marie: opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2389 with SDK v2 migration notes, a short batching example, and a tiny KMS snippet. preview: https://preview.redwood.dev/gh/2389. flagging for security/legal because of the KMS callout.
alex: thanks — i'll avoid embedding any real keys. current snippet uses `kms_client.authenticate('SAMPLE_TOKEN')` which i put as a placeholder while drafting.
secret-scan-bot: Secret scan: discovered potential pattern: 'SAMPLE_TOKEN' in docs (low confidence). Please confirm placeholder usage.
sanjay: security here. replace any token-like strings with `KMS_PLACEHOLDER` and avoid showing the full HSM path. also prefer linking to the kms integration guide instead of long inline code.
marie: agree with sanjay. can we also add a short note about who should see the KMS snippet (enterprise customers only)? keeps public docs clear.
linda-legal: i'll review for export/control language. quick ask: add a sentence about customer responsibility for key rotation and retention. i'll add inline comments on the PR tomorrow.
alex: pushed fixes (commit 9b2a4fa) — removed `SAMPLE_TOKEN`, changed to `KMS_PLACEHOLDER`, trimmed the HSM path to `/kms/<key-id>` and added a link to /guides/kms-integration. preview rebuilt: https://preview.redwood.dev/gh/2389/build/5.
ci-bot: Docs preview build passed (5). Linkcheck: ok. Visual diffs: 3 files.
marie: i left some wording suggestions to shorten the migration example (users copy long blocks). collapse the code block and add `# full example in guides`.
alex: collapsed snippet and added the pointer. pushed 9b2a4fb.
secret-scan-bot: Re-scan: no high-confidence secrets detected.
sanjay: security ack pending legal sign-off. nothing blocking from infra standpoint.
linda-legal: reviewed and left two nits on phrasing; none critical. will sign off after those edits.
marie: once legal signs off, can we plan to merge during a quiet window? prefer 23:00 PST to avoid peak support hours.
release-manager: 23:00 PST works for release scheduling. please ensure no infra deploys overlap.
alex: edited the two nits and pushed 9b2a4fc. requesting approvals: @sanjay @linda-legal @marie for merge.
sanjay: approved.
linda-legal: approved.
marie: approved and scheduling merge at 1950058800 (23:00 PST). tagging changelog entry.
ci-bot: Merge queued — auto-merge scheduled for 1950058800.
alex: created internal follow-up ticket DOCS-412 to add a one-page 'redaction + placeholder' guide for authors. thanks all for quick turnaround.
marie: nice, closing thread. :party_parrot:
